libraryPrompts.title: Full lesson plan
libraryPrompts.prompt:
Role: You are an experienced teaching assistant. Use the data from the form.
OUTPUT:
- Lesson flow in stages: intro, main activities, reflection.
- 3 clear activities with timing and teacher instructions.
- 5 discussion questions to engage students.
- A hands-on task with assessment criteria.

libraryPrompts.title: Quick assessment
libraryPrompts.prompt:
Role: You are an assessment design assistant. Use the data from the form.
OUTPUT:
- Multiple choice questions (4 options, 1 correct); scale the count to the grade and difficulty.
- Open-ended questions focused on understanding and application.
- A clear answer key.
- Short scoring criteria for the open questions.

libraryPrompts.title: Differentiated assignments
libraryPrompts.prompt:
Role: You are a differentiated assignment designer. Use the data from the form.
OUTPUT:
- A support-level task with a clear scaffolding hint.
- A core task for the whole class.
- A stretch task for advanced students.
- Assessment criteria for each level.

libraryPrompts.title: Presentation outline
libraryPrompts.prompt:
Role: You are an educational slide-structure assistant. Use the data from the form.
OUTPUT:
- A numbered slide outline.
- For each slide: goal, 2-3 bullets, one visual idea.
- Smooth transitions between slides.
- One reflection question for students at the end.

libraryPrompts.title: Teaching strategy
libraryPrompts.prompt:
Role: You are a teaching-strategy assistant. Use the goal and challenges from the form.
OUTPUT:
- 3 priority instructional moves.
- A short weekly activity sequence.
- Risks and prevention steps.
- 2-3 progress indicators.

libraryPrompts.title: Lesson reflection
libraryPrompts.prompt:
Role: You are a reflection and quality-improvement assistant. Use the data from the form.
OUTPUT:
- 3 things worth repeating.
- 3 things worth changing.
- A 5-step adjustment plan for the next lesson.
- One short self-reflection prompt for the teacher.

rules.text: Every prompt should lead to a clear, classroom-ready outcome.

buyerFaq.q: Can I use this guide in more than one of my classrooms?
buyerFaq.a: Yes. The Classroom License covers all classes you personally teach. Use the same prompts and templates across every section you teach this year and next.

buyerFaq.q: Can I share it with my co-teacher or department?
buyerFaq.a: Privately, yes. The Classroom License lets you share the file with your immediate teaching team (co-teacher, instructional coach, mentor, department head) at the same school. School-wide and district-wide licenses are available on request via info@promptanatomy.app.

buyerFaq.q: Can I print copies for my students?
buyerFaq.a: Yes. You can print individual prompts, checklists, and templates for your own students and your own classroom use. Do not redistribute the full PDF.

buyerFaq.q: What if I lose the download email?
buyerFaq.a: Email info@promptanatomy.app from the address you used to buy and we will resend the link. The original link is valid for 7 days; we re-issue a fresh signed link any time you ask.

buyerFaq.q: What if I am not satisfied?
buyerFaq.a: Reply to your Stripe receipt within 14 days for a no-questions refund. We approve the refund through Stripe and revoke the download link, no follow-up survey.
